objects.name: Library Administration
objects.desc: Involves the planning, organizing, staffing, directing, and controlling of library resources and activities to achieve the library's goals and serve its users; Notary services also available.

objects.name: Special Collections
objects.desc: Includes the Union College Archives, special book collections, manuscripts, and other primary source materials which document the College's history and support and extend its curriculum. The mission of Special Collections is to collect these materials, preserve them, and make them available to anyone with a valid need to use them. Schedule an appointment on their website or via email!
